sections.Profile:
The "Major League Baseball" pinball machine, produced by United Manufacturing Co. in July 1948, is a single-player electro-mechanical game with a baseball theme. The playfield features two flippers, six passive bumpers, and four kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: United Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Baseball, Sports, Original Theme
